parsed.name: 奥林巴斯 IX2 倒置显微镜机身
parsed.description: 奥林巴斯 IX2 是实验室用倒置显微镜机身，用于承载物镜、照明与调焦机构，并对样品进行显微观察。该类设备常用于细胞培养、活体样品观察、荧光成像及常规生物显微实验中的 Z 轴调焦和机身状态控制。
parsed.description_en: The Olympus IX2 is an inverted microscope body used in laboratories to support the objective turret, illumination, and focusing mechanisms for microscopic sample observation. It is commonly used for cell culture work, live-sample observation, fluorescence imaging, and general biological microscopy involving Z-axis focusing and microscope body status control.

actions.description_en: Send a query command to the microscope body.

actions.description: 使机身调焦机构按相对位移移动。
actions.description_en: Move the microscope focusing mechanism by a relative displacement.
